name: Learning
description: Persistent cross-game learning for OmniAI. With this enabled, OmniAI reads and writes memory.json in its own folder inside DMB's user data (the folder DMB hands it as OMNIAI_DIR), so it carries three things between sessions: how much each kind of map object turned out to be worth, a self-tuned threshold for how much stronger a guard has to be before a fight is refused, and which one-shot objects such as witch huts and shrines it has already used up. Turn this off to freeze learning without losing the file. Delete memory.json to reset a trained AI back to defaults. Off by default, because a trained AI plays differently from a fresh one and that should be a deliberate choice.
author: OmniAI project
